title: 第5章 血液第6章 九转金针

第〇五章 血液
琢磨了好一阵子，聂空也弄不明白这是怎么回事，或许是自己雷击死亡时，妖魔游戏也同时出了点问题，这才让紫罗幻灵香的种子跟着自己的灵魂意识来到天灵大陆，附在这具身体上。
既然种子已经在丹田里了，以现在的条件又取不出来，再怎么担心也没用。是福不是祸，是祸躲不过。
这么一想，聂空定下心来，继续集中精神观察体内情况。
果然如切脉时所料，这具身体的经脉全部被一些翠绿的东西堵塞，而这些东西竟全是已凝结成实质的灵力。在灵力的表层，还密密麻麻地附贴着大量白蒙蒙的物事，聂空能感觉得出，这些都是自己这十多年所服用灵药的药力，它们没有消散，没有被身体吸收，一直凝聚在经脉中。
天灵大陆灵力修炼体系发达，但并没有十二正经、奇经八脉等经络穴位之类的概念。以聂青阳融灵九品的实力，早就发现了聂空体内这些灵力的存在。
他不但自己出手，也曾请家族一位御灵级别的长辈帮聂空疏通身体，可惜他们都不明白其中的缘由，经常是震碎一部分灵力、对其他的灵力动手时，前面散开的灵力又重新聚集，结果徒劳无功。
由于天地间灵力充沛，这里的人很少患病，即便是得病，运用灵力也能轻松治愈，像聂空这种连御灵师都治不好的病症，那就是绝症，基本可以宣判死亡了。因此，几乎所有人都断言，聂空将和他哥哥聂穹一样，活不过十八岁。
“如果修炼‘五星挪移’后，导致静脉淤塞，百病缠身，这倒是正常。可在修炼之前也是病怏怏的，这又是为什么？而且，又是什么原因导致灵力堵塞经脉的呢？”聂空很是疑惑的嘀咕道。
聂穹的情况和他一样，只撑了十八年，两兄弟症状相同，莫非是遗传？聂青阳非常健康，那就只能是传自母亲那边了。
聂空并不清楚她的情况，只知道父亲聂青阳年轻时出去游历过，数年后回家时带着三岁的聂穹和襁褓中的聂空，至于孩子母亲，据聂青阳说是生聂空时难产而死，所以，聂空比聂穹更加病弱，能活到和哥哥相同的岁数，简直是奇迹。
“看来经脉淤塞并非患病的主因，导致经脉淤塞的原因才是根源。”聂空暗忖。片刻后，他不再刻意查找病因，开始静心修炼“五星挪移”。
灵诀从心间源源不断地闪过，丹田内的灵神三窍极富韵律地轻微震动，天地灵力如丝如缕地灌入体内。
聂空是聚灵一品，修炼的又是最基础的通用灵诀，天地灵力进入后，只有极少量的木灵力元素才会存留在灵神三窍。
另外，聂空吸收的速度极慢，那些木灵力元素会大部消散，能被真正炼化为己用的不到两成。这样的速度，如果换做别人，早就放弃修炼了，聂空坚持了十年，其毅力和耐性可见一斑。
时间缓缓流逝，聂空并不急躁，意识完全沉浸于修炼中，细心体味着灵力的进入与消散……
——————————————————————————————————————————————
恍惚间，感觉到有脚步声进入房中，应该是花眉送粥进来，聂空并未停止修炼，那脚步声又渐渐远去，轻盈如猫儿。此后，房门口又多次出现细微的动静，想是花眉来看看他有没有醒来。
终于，空荡荡的灵神三窍内出现了一丝微弱的灵力。就在这时，突然有种奇异的力量如波纹般从全身血脉中扩散开来，紧接着窍穴内辛苦炼化出来的灵力竟缓缓消散，融入经脉。那股力量异常微弱，如果不是聂空这个中医医师对人体的结构非常了解，根本察觉不到它的来源。
“哈哈，终于找到了！”

聂空猛地睁开眼睛，大喜道，“血液！根源竟在血液！”
“哎呀。”
正蹑手蹑脚走进房间的花眉就像是被踩着尾巴的猫儿般，吓得惊叫起来。回过神来后，见聂空愕然地看着自己，花眉白皙的脸蛋变得红扑扑的，有些手足无措的道：“叔叔，你修炼好了？粥已经凉了，我换过一碗来。”
聂空失笑道：“嫂嫂，不用了。”床头桌面上的粥碗还有点温热，聂空真是饿了，马上化身饿死鬼投胎。
花眉偷偷瞟去，见聂空狼吞虎咽的馋样，唇角露出了微微的笑意，却忍不住道：“叔叔，你喝慢点，厨房里还有。”
一碗粥下肚，聂空精神振奋了些，放下碗后突然想起一桩最紧要的事情：“对了，嫂嫂，我们家还有多少钱。”
“只有四十三个金币了，叔叔，够用吗？”手指挠了挠衣袖，花眉苦着小脸，有些担心的道。
“足够了，估计二十个金币就差不多，我明天去弄点治病的东西。”聂空估算了下，这里的金价远不如前世昂贵，打造九根金针花不了多少钱。
“二十金币，这么便宜？”
花眉难以置信地张着小嘴，要知道那些灵师炼制的灵药都非常贵，以前都是一次性几百、几千甚至是上万金币那么花出去的，不然父亲聂青阳战死后的那几万抚恤金也不会花得那么快。
看着花眉傻呆呆的模样，聂空大笑：“嫂嫂，明天你就知道了。”
“哦哦。”
花眉愣愣地点着脑袋，可一看到聂空那灿烂的笑容，不觉脸上有点发热，忙端起碗道：“叔叔，我再去舀碗粥来。”
“多谢嫂嫂。”
花眉快步出了房间，心儿怦怦的有点发慌，不知为何，她感觉聂空这次从昏迷中醒来后就有点不一样了。以前的聂空虽然敬她，但说话时都是硬邦邦的，从不会像现在这样和颜悦色；而且，以前的聂空一直冷冰冰的，从来都不笑，可今天聂空笑的次数却比近三年加起来的都多。
虽然现在的叔叔感觉有点陌生，可相比起来，她还是喜欢现在的叔叔……这么想着，花眉的脚步更加轻快起来……
房内，聂空神色变得有些凝重。
此刻静下心来，他才发觉，在感应到血脉中那股力量的前一刹那，灵神三窍之间的紫罗幻灵香种子曾轻轻地颤了一颤，而后他的感官竟似骤然敏锐了一倍，这才让他发现了那股奇异力量的存在。
难道那种力量和紫罗幻灵香种子有着某种关联？

Chapter 05 Blood
After pondering for a long time, Nie Kong couldn't figure out what was going on. Perhaps when he died from a lightning strike, something went wrong in the demon game at the same time. This allowed the seeds of the Purple Phantom Incense to follow his soul consciousness to the Tianling Continent and attach itself to this body.
Since the seeds are already in the Dantian and cannot be taken out under the current conditions, there is no point in worrying. It's a blessing, not a curse, but it's a curse that cannot be avoided.
With this thought, Nie Kong calmed down and continued to concentrate on observing the situation inside his body.
As expected when the pulse was cut, all the meridians of this body were blocked by some emerald green things, and these things were actually spiritual power that had been condensed into substance. On the surface of the spiritual power, there are still a large number of white things densely attached. Nie Kong can feel that these are the medicinal power of the elixir he has taken for more than ten years. They have not dissipated or been absorbed by the body, and have been condensed in the meridians.
Tianling Continent has a well-developed spiritual power cultivation system, but there is no such concept as twelve main meridians, eight extraordinary meridians, and other meridians and acupuncture points. With Nie Qingyang's ninth-grade Rongling strength, he had already discovered the existence of these spiritual powers in Nie Kong's body.
Not only did he take action himself, but he also asked an elder in the family to help Nie Kong unblock his body. Unfortunately, they didn't understand the reason. Often when he shattered a part of the spiritual power and attacked other spiritual powers, the scattered spiritual power regrouped, and the result was in vain.
Due to the abundant spiritual power between heaven and earth, people here rarely get sick. Even if they do get sick, they can be easily cured by using spiritual power. Diseases like Nie Kong that even spiritual masters cannot cure are terminal illnesses and can basically lead to death. Therefore, almost everyone asserted that Nie Kong, like his brother Nie Qiong, would not survive until the age of eighteen.
"It is normal if after practicing the 'Five Star Shift', your veins become clogged and you suffer from all kinds of diseases. But before you practice, you were also ill. Why is that? And what causes spiritual power to block the meridians?" Nie Kong muttered in confusion.
Nie Qiong's condition was the same as his, and he only lasted eighteen years. The two brothers had the same symptoms. Could it be hereditary? Nie Qingyang is very healthy, so it can only be passed down from his mother.
Nie Kong didn't know much about her situation. He only knew that his father, Nie Qingyang, traveled when he was young. A few years later, he returned home with three-year-old Nie Qiong and infant Nie Kong. As for the child's mother, according to Nie Qingyang, she died of dystocia when giving birth to Nie Kong. Therefore, Nie Kong was even sicker than Nie Qiong. It was a miracle that he could live to the same age as his brother.
"It seems that the congestion of the meridians is not the main cause of the disease, but the cause of the congestion of the meridians is the root cause." Nie Kong thought to himself. After a while, he stopped searching for the cause of the disease and began to practice "Five Star Movement" quietly.
The spiritual secrets flashed continuously from the heart, the three spiritual orifices in the Dantian vibrated slightly and rhythmically, and the spiritual power of heaven and earth poured into the body like threads.
Nie Kong is a first-level spirit gatherer, and he practices the most basic universal spiritual techniques. After the spiritual power of heaven and earth enters, only a very small amount of wood spiritual power elements will remain in the three spiritual orifices.
In addition, Nie Kong's absorption speed is extremely slow, and most of the wood spiritual power elements will dissipate, and less than 20% can be truly refined for his own use. At such a speed, if it were anyone else, they would have given up practicing long ago. Nie Kong persisted for ten years, which shows his perseverance and patience.
Time passed slowly, and Nie Kong was not impatient. His consciousness was completely immersed in cultivation, and he carefully experienced the entry and dissipation of spiritual power...
————————————————————————————————————————————
In a daze, he felt footsteps entering the room. It should be Huamei bringing porridge. Nie Kong did not stop practicing, and the footsteps gradually faded away, as light as a cat. After that, there were subtle movements at the door of the room many times, thinking it was Huamei coming to see if he was awake.
Finally, emptyA weak spiritual power appeared in the three spiritual orifices. At this moment, a strange power suddenly spread out from the blood vessels throughout the body like ripples, and then the spiritual power that had been painstakingly refined in the acupoints slowly dissipated and merged into the meridians. That force was so weak that if it weren't for Nie Kong, a Chinese medicine doctor who knew the structure of the human body very well, he wouldn't have been able to detect its source.
"Haha, I finally found it!"
Nie Kong suddenly opened his eyes and said with great joy, "Blood! The root is actually blood!"
"Oops."
Huamei, who was tiptoeing into the room, screamed in fright like a cat whose tail was stepped on. After coming back to his senses, he saw Nie Kong looking at him in astonishment, his fair face turning red, and he said at a loss: "Uncle, have you finished practicing? The porridge has gone cold. I'll bring you a bowl."
Nie Kong laughed and said, "Sister-in-law, no need." The porridge bowl on the bedside table was still a little warm. Nie Kong was really hungry and immediately reincarnated as a starving ghost.
Huamei peeked over secretly and saw Nie Kong devouring the food greedily. A slight smile appeared on her lips, but she couldn't help but said: "Uncle, drink slowly, there are still some in the kitchen."
After eating a bowl of porridge, Nie Kong became more energetic. After putting down the bowl, he suddenly remembered the most important thing: "By the way, sister-in-law, how much money does our family have?"
"There are only forty-three gold coins left, uncle, are they enough?" He scratched his sleeves with his fingers, and said with a worried look on his face.
"It's enough. I think twenty gold coins will be enough. I'll get some medical supplies tomorrow." Nie Kong estimated that the price of gold here was far less expensive than in his previous life, and it wouldn't cost much to make nine golden needles.
"Twenty gold coins, so cheap?"
Huamei opened her mouth in disbelief. You must know that the elixirs refined by spiritual masters are very expensive. In the past, they used to be spent on hundreds, thousands or even tens of thousands of gold coins at a time. Otherwise, the tens of thousands of pensions after the death of his father Nie Qingyang would not have been spent so quickly.
Looking at Huamei's dumb look, Nie Kong laughed and said, "Sister-in-law, you will know tomorrow."
"Oh."
Huamei nodded blankly, but when she saw Nie Kong's bright smile, her face felt a little hot. She quickly picked up the bowl and said, "Uncle, I'll scoop out another bowl of porridge."
"Thank you, sister-in-law."
Huamei hurried out of the room, her heart pounding and a little panicked. For some reason, she felt that Nie Kong was a little different after he woke up from his coma. Although Nie Kong respected her in the past, he was stiff when he spoke and was never as kind as he is now. Moreover, Nie Kong was always cold and never smiled, but today Nie Kong smiled more times than in the past three years combined.
Although the current uncle feels a bit strange, in comparison, she still likes the current uncle... Thinking of this, Huamei's steps become more brisk...
In the room, Nie Kong's expression became a little solemn.
When he calmed down, he realized that the moment before he sensed the power in his blood, the purple phantom incense seeds between the three orifices of the Spirit God trembled slightly, and then his senses suddenly seemed to be twice as sharp, which allowed him to discover the existence of that strange power.
Is there some connection between that power and the purple phantom incense seeds?
